name: CE-123
summary: CE-123, or as the active enantiomer (S)-CE-123, is an analog of modafinil, the most researched of a series of structurally related heterocyclic derivatives. In animal studies, CE-123 was found to improve performance on tests of learning and memory in a manner consistent with a nootropic effect profile.

uses.text: (S)-CE-123 has pro-motivational effects in animals, reverses tetrabenazine-induced motivational deficits, and could be useful in the treatment of motivational disorders in humans.

pharmacology.en: It blocks the dopamine transporter, raising dopamine levels between nerve cells, and is much more selective for dopamine than modafinil is. It is described as an atypical dopamine reuptake inhibitor, meaning it seems to act differently from cocaine-like drugs at the same site.
pharmacology.zh: 它會阻斷多巴胺轉運體，提高神經細胞之間的多巴胺濃度，而且對多巴胺的選擇性比莫達非尼高得多。它被歸類為非典型多巴胺回收抑制劑，意思是它在同一作用位置上的表現，似乎與古柯鹼類藥物不同。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它会阻断多巴胺转运体，提高神经细胞之间的多巴胺浓度，而且对多巴胺的选择性比莫达非尼高得多。它被归类为非典型多巴胺回收抑制剂，意思是它在同一作用位置上的表现，似乎与古柯碱类药物不同。

fact.en: It was modelled on modafinil, a wakefulness drug that grew out of work by the French company Lafon Laboratories in the 1970s.
fact.zh: 它是仿照莫達非尼設計的。莫達非尼是一種促清醒藥物，源自法國拉豐實驗室在 1970 年代的研究。
fact.zhHans: 它是仿照莫达非尼设计的。莫达非尼是一种促清醒药物，源自法国拉丰实验室在 1970 年代的研究。
